title: Global Logistics Coordinator Flight Sourcing
business: A boutique international logistics firm managing urgent spare parts delivery for global manufacturing clients.
problem: Coordinators spend excessive time manually cross-referencing flight availability across multiple airline portals to meet tight delivery windows, leading to delayed logistics planning.
solution: By integrating the Kiwi.com connector into Claude, coordinators can query real-time flight availability directly within the chat interface, allowing the AI to parse complex routing requirements and suggest optimal flight paths based on specific cargo constraints.
steps: Install the Kiwi.com connector via the Claude Desktop or web interface settings.
Define the logistics constraints, including origin, destination, and required arrival time, within a Claude chat session.
Invoke the search-flight tool to retrieve available flight options that match the specified criteria.
Refine the search results by asking Claude to filter for specific cabin classes or passenger counts if additional personnel are accompanying the cargo.
Review the generated flight options and select the most efficient route for the logistics plan.
outcome: Coordinators achieve a streamlined workflow where flight sourcing is integrated into the planning process, reducing the cognitive load of switching between disparate travel booking platforms.
limitation: The connector provides flight search data but does not execute final bookings; users must verify availability and finalize transactions directly on the Kiwi.com platform, which can be checked by reviewing the tool output for booking links versus direct confirmation statuses.
